Projects.imageCaption: From scientific data to technical decisions

items.title: Environmental and Social Impact Assessment (ESIA) & Mining Waste Management
items.summary: Physico-chemical characterisation of solid and liquid waste, dispersion modelling and the project's environmental management plan (PGEP).
items.description: Rigorous inventory and sampling of metallurgical treatment effluents. Assessment of impacts on surface water, groundwater and neighbouring agricultural soils, together with a remediation and residue-containment plan.

technicalDetails.capacity: Supervision of 3 extraction sites and concentrators
technicalDetails.footprint: Mining watershed of more than 450 km²
technicalDetails.impact: Protection of village drinking-water sources and prevention of acid mine drainage
technologies: Physico-chemical analysis in a certified laboratory

items.title: Feasibility Study & Solar-Powered Drinking Water Supply
items.summary: Spring catchment, deep boreholes, water-tower sizing and installation of gravity-fed and solar distribution networks.
items.description: Complete design of drinking-water supply master plans to connect vulnerable populations. Integration of hybrid solar pumps and compact chlorination and sand-filtration units.

technicalDetails.footprint: 42 km linear network of HDPE and cast-iron pipes
technicalDetails.impact: Eradication of water-borne disease outbreaks in the intervention areas

items.title: Environmental Audit & Neutralisation of Industrial Liquid Effluents
items.summary: Comprehensive environmental diagnosis of industrial liquid effluents and deployment of neutralisation stations with closed-loop recycling.
items.description: Technical audit of acid-generating hydrometallurgical processes. Design of lamella settlers, lime-based physico-chemical treatment and stabilised-sludge settling basins enabling process water recycling.

technicalDetails.capacity: Treatment of 8,500 m³/day of acidic effluents
technicalDetails.impact: Zero toxic discharge into the public hydrographic network

items.title: Continuous Monitoring & Laboratory Analysis (Water, Soil & Air Quality)
items.summary: State-of-the-art laboratory for quality control of drinking water, industrial waste, settleable dust and atmospheric gases.
items.description: Quarterly sampling and analysis campaigns under a controlled cold chain. Production of detailed ecological assessments helping industry and public authorities make informed decisions.

technicalDetails.capacity: Capacity of 450 complete physico-chemical analyses / month
technicalDetails.footprint: Network of 24 monitoring stations across the DRC
technicalDetails.impact: Production of reference figures for the Ministry of the Environment
technologies: Mobile multi-gas analysers (SO₂, NOₓ, CO, PM2.5 / PM10)

items.title: Continuing Education Programme for Water and Mining Executives & Technicians
items.client: Katanga mining companies, State agents, researchers
items.summary: High-level skills transfer in environmental management, environmental auditing and hydraulic modelling software.
items.description: Certified training modules led by university professors and EWES experts, in partnership with the polytechnic faculties of Lubumbashi (UNILU), Liège (Belgium), Lorraine (France) and Montréal (Canada).

technicalDetails.impact: Local teams empowered to operate complex infrastructure
technologies: Decontamination and restoration of mining sites

items.title: Computer-Aided Design & Civil Engineering Site Supervision
items.summary: Civil engineering studies, 3D/BIM modelling, structure mock-ups and rigorous on-site execution control.
items.description: Owner's engineering support for the construction of reinforced-concrete water reservoirs, stormwater culverts and administrative and technical buildings.

technicalDetails.capacity: Supervision of more than 18 simultaneous sites
technologies: Fresh and hardened concrete testing (sclerometer, core sampling)
